purpose: 本地知识扩展的声明式契约；插件只能补充证据，不能覆盖核心占星体系。
invariants: candidate/auxiliary plugins may not raise evidence above grade_cap C
timing_only plugins remain inactive unless the caller explicitly activates timing
every output must carry card_id, source_ids, grade_cap and safety_gate
plugin changes are versioned; replacement uses supersedes and rollback_to
context_only plugins/cards never enter a core conclusion
active/candidate plugins must declare an event domain and an event mechanism
a sign/planet/house definition without an event mechanism is not a judgment
every callable plugin must declare a stable invocation symbol, aliases, trigger and fallback
